visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white cat with blue eyes and a red collar walks away from the camera through a modern, minimalist apartment with light-colored wood flooring and neutral walls. (2) The camera cuts to the cat sitting against a grey backdrop, now wearing a stylized red McDonald's employee collar and bowtie. A yellow McDonald's logo and signage are visible behind it. (3) The cat is seen walking down a spacious, marble-tiled building hallway. A miniature red McDonald's delivery bag toy is attached to its collar, bobbing as it moves toward a dark-wood apartment door. (4) A man in a brown shirt and shorts opens the door. The cat stops, and the man reaches down to interact with the miniature delivery box and pet the cat. (5) Several close-up shots showcase various miniature McDonald's kitchen toys, including a chicken nugget box, a beverage dispenser, and a grill. A tabby cat with a red collar is shown sniffing and interacting with these detailed plastic toys. (6) A screen recording shows a finger navigating the McDonald's mobile app to select a specific meal deal. (7) The tabby cat sits calmly behind a full display of the 'Little McDonald's Pretend Play' toy collection on a flat surface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo synthesized pop BGM begins immediately. A male narrator provides energetic Traditional Chinese commentary with high vocal arousal. Short 'pop' SFX and digital 'dings' synchronize with text appearing on screen. (2) A sharp 'thud' and 'creak' SFX represent a door opening. The narrator's tone remains friendly and enthusiastic. Soft percussive clinks of plastic objects are audible during the delivery scene. (3) The music maintains its driving rhythm. A cartoonish 'slide' SFX accompanies the cat's movement. The narrator describes the McDonald's promotion in a professional yet humorous broadcasting style. (4) Vocal density increases as specific toy names are listed. Digital UI SFX (clicks and swipes) are layered over the mix during the phone screen recording segment. (5) The audio concludes with a final cheerful musical stinger and a playful 'ding' as the brand logo is emphasized.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a creative commercial promoting McDonald's Taiwan's 'Little McDonald's Pretend Play 2.0' (小麥麥家家酒) toy set. It uses the narrative of a cat acting as a delivery person to 'hook' the audience before showcasing the detailed miniature kitchen toys and providing a call-to-action to use the McDonald's app to collect them.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of brand logo, product demonstration, app navigation, and explicit promotional dates and conditions.
